llm_response.reason: The website mimics the appearance and branding of the legitimate company Sorel, offering only Sorel-branded products at discounted prices with 'Lowest Price Guarantee' claims. It lacks real company registration or contact information, using only a generic Gmail address for communication. No proper privacy or business identification is found, strongly indicating a scam. These factors match many of the well-known fake online shopping scam criteria: brand spoofing, non-existent company info, inappropriate contact details, and ambiguity about terms and privacy.
